data.raw_text:
Ang pagpunta sa Luneta at EDSA ay kampanya laban sa korapsyon. Hindi ito kampanya ng partidong sinusuportahan mo, kundi isang araw ng pagkakaisa. Wala itong kinakatawang kulay, kundi tanging pagpili lamang ng mas magandang Pilipinas. 

Sa lahat po ng dadalo sa rally mamaya, mag-ingat po tayong lahat. Ito ay hindi lamang pagtitipon, kundi paninindigan para sa katotohanan, katarungan, at kinabukasan ng ating bayan.

Manindigan. Makielam. Lumaban. 

#BahaSaLuneta #TrillionPesoMarch

data.english_translation: Visiting Luneta and EDSA is a campaign against bankruptcy. This is not a campaign of the party you support, but a day of unity. It represents no colour, but only the choice of a better Philippines. Of all those who come to rally later, let us be careful. This is not just a gathering, but a stand for the truth, justice, and the future of our people. Take your stand.
